## {{< fa image-portrait >}} | Summary
<!-- - Early career researcher in gravitational wave astronomy
- Physicist by background
- Specialised in data analysis of gravitational waves
- Leveraging machine learning and statistical techniques -->

As a researcher and physicist, I tackle data analysis problems in gravitational wave astronomy using statistical and machine learning techniques.

I've worked with [LIGO](https://www.ligo.caltech.edu/) and [LISA](https://www.esa.int/Science_Exploration/Space_Science/LISA) on problems such as detecting unexpected noise sources, quantifying statistical biases, and ML-based approaches to noise removal.

My contributions will help to facilitate proposed tests of general relativity and astrophysics, ensuring they can be performed with minimal compromise.
